summary: BIL & LAKKSERVICE AS (org. no. 998 584 477) is a private limited company (AS) based in Tromsø, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-07-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.810 (Detaljhandel med motorvogner); it has 18 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 28.4 m and net income was NOK 1.9 m. Board chair: Vegard Strømnes; auditor: ALFA REVISJON AS.
